column1: # Game profile of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion (Switch, update 1.0.7 = v393216). Plays on the Mac from the logos through the title screen, the menus and the mission select into a stage, at 60 fps, with sound (see README.md)
# Tribute Games' engine ("Paris") on FNA, compiled with .NET NativeAOT (NativeAOT-NX), SDK 20.5.15. FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver on SDL's Vulkan backend, which looks every vk* function up
# through vkGetInstanceProcAddr: the host's Vulkan layer (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m) answers it, so NVIDIA's Vulkan and OpenGL drivers (subsdk0, subsdk1) are not loaded. FMOD for sound,
# Epic Online Services in an NRO the host does not load (its imports answer offline, hle_eos.c)
# FNA's MOJOSHADER translates the effects' D3D9 bytecode (Content/Shaders/*.fxb and FNA's own effects) to SPIR-V at run time, and the RomFS has no SPIR-V file, so the NSP script
# captures them by booting the game on the Mac (vk_capture.tsv lists the keys); vk_shaders.py translates the capture
# main imports nothing from subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan) and subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL) the host does not supply: not loaded
# FMOD banks, the game's data files, the EOS NRO and the Ogg Theora movies do not compress
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: Engage's 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself.
# Measured on the Mac: the regions reach alias +4.07 GB in the first 15 s (malloc's 2.5 GB, the GC's 1.5 GB and a few small ones)
# .NET NativeAOT: the GC's region range is 1.5 GB instead of 5 × its hard limit, and malloc's StandardAllocator over 40 GB gets 2.5 GB, so both fit (Absolum's split,
# docs/reference/memory.md); without them the runtime fails to start and the game calls exit(1) in nnMain

column2: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion has no NVN shaders (its SPIR-V shaders go through the Vulkan layer)
